text: Na forma tradicional de nomear os días, se o luns é a segunda feira, que día é a sexta feira?
gloss: In the traditional naming of weekdays, if Monday is the 'second feria', which day is the 'sixth feria'? — Friday (venres): luns 2ª, martes 3ª, mércores 4ª, xoves 5ª, venres 6ª.

text: En galego, «coa» é a contracción de dúas palabras. Cales?
gloss: In Galician, «coa» is a contraction of two words. Which? — con + a ('with the', feminine); con + o gives «co».

text: Se quen fai o pan é o panadeiro, como se chama quen fai zocos?
gloss: If the one who makes bread is the panadeiro, what is the one who makes clogs (zocos) called? — Zoqueiro: zoco + -eiro; the zapateiro makes shoes (zapatos).

text: Como se escribe en galego normativo o número 19?
gloss: How is 19 written in standard Galician? — Dezanove (RAG norm); dezenove is Portuguese, the others are non-standard.

text: Na froitaría levas medio quilo de tomates e un cuarto de quilo de pementos. Cantos gramos son en total?
gloss: At the greengrocer's you take half a kilo of tomatoes and a quarter kilo of peppers. How many grams in total? — 750 g: 500 + 250.

text: Nun correo electrónico, que quere dicir o campo «CC»?
gloss: In an email, what does the «CC» field mean? — 'With copy' (carbon copy): the message also goes to those addresses.

text: En que unidade aparece na factura da luz a electricidade que consumiches?
gloss: In what unit does the electricity bill show the energy you used? — kWh, kilowatt-hours, a unit of energy.

text: Pagas cunha tarxeta sen contacto e o importe supera o límite. Que che pide entón o datáfono?
gloss: You pay with a contactless card and the amount is over the limit. What does the card terminal then ask for? — The PIN; below the limit a tap is enough.

text: Que imposto, xeralmente do 21 %, vai incluído no prezo de case todo o que compramos?
gloss: Which tax, generally 21%, is included in the price of almost everything we buy? — IVE (VAT); IRPF is income tax, IBI property tax, IAE business tax.

text: A que número se chama nunha emerxencia en calquera país da Unión Europea?
gloss: Which number do you call in an emergency in any EU country? — 112, the single European emergency number.

text: En que se serve tradicionalmente o polbo á feira?
gloss: What is pulpo á feira traditionally served on? — A wooden plate.

text: Que froito seco é o ingrediente principal da tarta de Santiago?
gloss: Which nut is the main ingredient of the tarta de Santiago? — Almond.

text: Como se chama a procesión de ánimas en pena que, segundo a tradición, percorre de noite os camiños de Galicia?
gloss: What is the procession of souls in torment that, by tradition, walks Galicia's roads at night? — The Santa Compaña.

text: Vigo é a cidade máis poboada de Galicia. En que provincia está?
gloss: Vigo is Galicia's most populous city. Which province is it in? — Pontevedra (the trap: it is not a provincial capital).

text: Que cuncha levan como distintivo os peregrinos do Camiño de Santiago?
gloss: Which shell do pilgrims on the Way of St James wear as their badge? — The scallop (vieira).

text: Como se lle chama en galego ao carnaval, con festas sonadas en Xinzo de Limia ou Verín?
gloss: What is carnival called in Galician, with famous festivities in Xinzo de Limia or Verín? — Entroido.

text: Que árbore de orixe australiana cobre hoxe boa parte dos montes galegos?
gloss: Which tree of Australian origin now covers much of Galicia's hills? — The eucalyptus.

text: Que cidade portuguesa á beira do Douro lle deu nome a un viño doce coñecido en todo o mundo?
gloss: Which Portuguese city on the Douro gave its name to a sweet wine known worldwide? — Porto (port wine).

text: Que marca de roupa, hoxe presente en medio mundo, abriu a súa primeira tenda na Coruña en 1975?
gloss: Which clothing brand, now in half the world, opened its first shop in A Coruña in 1975? — Zara (Inditex; Bershka and Pull&Bear came later).

text: En que videoxogo de mundos feitos de bloques cúbicos hai que fuxir dos «creepers»?
gloss: In which video game of worlds built from cubic blocks do you flee from 'creepers'? — Minecraft.

text: Que deporte de raqueta se xoga sempre por parellas, nunha pista pechada con paredes de vidro?
gloss: Which racket sport is always played in pairs, on an enclosed court with glass walls? — Padel.

text: No baloncesto, un equipo anota dous triples e un tiro libre. Cantos puntos suma?
gloss: In basketball, a team scores two three-pointers and one free throw. How many points? — 7: 3 + 3 + 1.

text: Que moeda se usaba en España antes da chegada do euro?
gloss: Which currency was used in Spain before the euro arrived? — The peseta (the escudo was Portugal's).

text: Que queixo galego con denominación de orixe ten forma de cono, coma un peito?
gloss: Which Galician PDO cheese is cone-shaped, like a breast? — Tetilla ('little breast'); San Simón is pear-shaped and smoked, Cebreiro mushroom-shaped.

text: En que concurso musical os países reparten os seus «douze points»?
gloss: In which music contest do countries hand out their 'douze points'? — Eurovision.

text: Quen escribiu o poema «Negra sombra», que Xoán Montes converteu nunha canción?
gloss: Who wrote the poem «Negra sombra», set to music by Xoán Montes? — Rosalía de Castro (in «Follas novas», 1880).

text: Que serie española de atracadores con monos vermellos e máscaras de Dalí arrasou en Netflix?
gloss: Which Spanish series about robbers in red jumpsuits and Dalí masks was a Netflix hit? — «La casa de papel» (Money Heist).

text: Que mide o índice UV que dá o parte meteorolóxico no verán?
gloss: What does the UV index in the summer weather forecast measure? — Ultraviolet radiation from the sun.

text: Como se chama o lugar da cociña tradicional galega onde se fai o lume?
gloss: What is the place in a traditional Galician kitchen where the fire is made? — The lareira (hearth); palleira is a hayloft, alpendre a shed, adega a wine cellar.

text: En que tempada gañou o Deportivo da Coruña a súa única Liga?
gloss: In which season did Deportivo de La Coruña win its only league title? — 1999-2000 (in 1993-94 they lost it on the last day).

text: Que actor deu vida a Ramón Sampedro, o mariñeiro de Porto do Son, en «Mar adentro»?
gloss: Which actor played Ramón Sampedro, the sailor from Porto do Son, in «Mar adentro»? — Javier Bardem (Amenábar's 2004 film).

text: Que mestre medieval esculpiu o Pórtico da Gloria da catedral de Santiago?
gloss: Which medieval master carved the Pórtico da Gloria of Santiago cathedral? — Master Mateo (late 12th century).

text: No cumio dunha montaña moi alta, a que temperatura ferve a auga?
gloss: On top of a very high mountain, at what temperature does water boil? — Below 100 °C: lower air pressure lowers the boiling point.

text: Que significa a «s» do final de «https» nun enderezo web?
gloss: What does the final «s» of «https» stand for? — Secure (encrypted connection).

text: Un tren sae ás 23:40 e a viaxe dura 50 minutos. A que hora chega?
gloss: A train leaves at 23:40 and the trip takes 50 minutes. When does it arrive? — 00:30: 20 minutes to midnight, then 30 more.

text: Cal destes países europeos non ten saída ao mar?
gloss: Which of these European countries has no coastline? — Switzerland (Slovenia has a short Adriatic coast).

text: En que novela distópica o Gran Irmán vixía a todo o mundo?
gloss: In which dystopian novel does Big Brother watch everyone? — «1984», by George Orwell.

text: Que grupo vigués da Movida cantaba «Fai un sol de carallo»?
gloss: Which Vigo band of the Movida sang «Fai un sol de carallo»? — Os Resentidos, fronted by Antón Reixa (1986); the others were also from Vigo but sang in Spanish.

text: Que cidade inca, nos Andes do Perú, deu a coñecer ao mundo Hiram Bingham en 1911?
gloss: Which Inca city in the Peruvian Andes did Hiram Bingham make known to the world in 1911? — Machu Picchu.

text: O xoves galego é o día de Xúpiter; o «Thursday» inglés, o de que deus nórdico?
gloss: Galician xoves is Jupiter's day; English Thursday is which Norse god's? — Thor, the thunder god, matching Jupiter (Odin gave Wednesday).

text: Que lles dá aos flamengos a súa cor rosada?
gloss: What gives flamingos their pink colour? — What they eat: carotenoid pigments in algae and small crustaceans.

text: De que país é o kimchi, verdura fermentada e picante?
gloss: Which country is kimchi, spicy fermented vegetables, from? — Korea.

text: Que rianxeiro escribiu a novela «Os dous de sempre»?
gloss: Which man from Rianxo wrote the novel «Os dous de sempre»? — Castelao (1934).

text: En que concello se ergue o monte Santa Trega, co seu castro sobre a foz do Miño?
gloss: In which municipality does Mount Santa Trega, with its hillfort over the Miño estuary, stand? — A Guarda.

text: En galego, un billón é un millón de millóns. Cantos ceros ten?
gloss: In Galician a billón is a million millions. How many zeros does it have? — 12: 6 + 6 (unlike the English billion, 9).

text: Que país ten máis fusos horarios, contando os seus territorios de ultramar?
gloss: Which country has the most time zones, counting its overseas territories? — France, with 12 (Russia has 11; China uses only one).

text: Que cineasta mexicano dirixiu «O labirinto do fauno»?
gloss: Which Mexican filmmaker directed «Pan's Labyrinth»? — Guillermo del Toro (2006).

text: Que poeta de Celanova escribiu «Longa noite de pedra»?
gloss: Which poet from Celanova wrote «Longa noite de pedra»? — Celso Emilio Ferreiro (1962); Curros Enríquez, the trap, was also born in Celanova.

text: A que temperatura marcan o mesmo número un termómetro Celsius e un Fahrenheit?
gloss: At what temperature do a Celsius and a Fahrenheit thermometer show the same number? — −40: F = 1.8·C + 32 gives C = F at −40.

text: Que compositor austríaco escribiu a ópera «Wozzeck», baseada no drama de Büchner?
gloss: Which Austrian composer wrote the opera «Wozzeck», based on Büchner's play? — Alban Berg (premiered 1925).
